patch_description: Instead of a single greedy pass, this approach builds an initial feasible placement with a best-fit decreasing heuristic, then iteratively improves it with a local search: repeatedly find the GPU with the highest KVPR and try to move one of its models to another GPU (or swap with a model on another GPU) if it reduces the maximum KVPR. This hill-climbing rebalancing directly minimizes the objective rather than relying on a single myopic greedy assignment, typically yielding much lower max KVPR at negligible runtime cost.
